title: Referral Attribution Dispute with Conflicting Timestamps Across Systems
scenario_text:
**CRM — Opportunity: 'Helix BioSciences — Enterprise Platform'**
Close Date: Mar 15, 2026 | Amount: $290K ACV | Stage: Closed Won
Source Field: 'Partner Referral — TechForward Solutions'
Influence Field: [blank]
Created Date: Dec 8, 2025 | First Meeting: Dec 14, 2025

**PRM Portal — Deal Registration DR-2025-1189**
Partner: TechForward Solutions | Submitted: Dec 7, 2025 | Prospect: Helix BioSciences
Status: Approved | Approved by: marcus.chen | Referral type: Sourced

**PRM Portal — Deal Registration DR-2025-1203**
Partner: Quantum Consulting Group | Submitted: Dec 12, 2025 | Prospect: Helix Bio
Status: Rejected (Dec 13) | Reason: 'Duplicate — existing registration by TechForward (DR-2025-1189)'

**Slack — #channel-conflict (Jan 8, 2026, 11:22 AM)**
@derek.simmons [Quantum Consulting]: Marcus — contesting the DR rejection on Helix. We introduced their CTO to your AE at the Gartner event in November. That's sourced, not influenced. TechForward only filed first because we didn't know the prospect's legal name.
@marcus.chen: Let me pull the event logs. When exactly was the Gartner intro?
@derek.simmons: Nov 19. I can forward the email from their CTO thanking me for connecting them with your team.
@marcus.chen: Send it over. I'll review with the deal desk.

**Gmail — Forwarded to marcus.chen@meridian.io (Jan 9, 2026)**
From: derek.simmons@quantumconsulting.com
--- Forwarded message ---
From: r.nakamura@helixbio.com
To: derek.simmons@quantumconsulting.com
Date: Nov 20, 2025
Subject: Re: Great meeting you at Gartner

"Derek — thanks for introducing me to the Meridian team yesterday. Looking forward to the demo next week."

**Google Sheets — Gartner Summit Nov 2025 Lead Scan Export**
Row 47: 'R. Nakamura | Helix BioSciences | Scanned by: @lisa.tran [Meridian AE] | Nov 19, 2025 | Notes: met at partner reception, intro via Derek S (Quantum)'

**Slack — #partnerships (Jan 10, 2026, 4:55 PM)**
@marcus.chen: @raj.patel Helix attribution is messy. TechForward has the approved reg but Quantum has proof of first-touch at Gartner 3 weeks prior. Our policy is first-touch for sourced. But TechForward filed the reg first and it's already approved.
@raj.patel: What does the partner agreement say about contested regs after approval?
@marcus.chen: 'Approved registrations may be revisited within 30 days if new evidence of prior engagement is presented.' We're at day 34 from approval.
@raj.patel: :grimacing:
[No further messages]
question: Who should receive 'sourced' referral credit for the Helix BioSciences opportunity?

contributor.name: Marcus Chen
contributor.title: Partner Program Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Partner tiering, deal registration, referral attribution, channel conflict resolution, co-sell motions

choices: Quantum Consulting Group — the evidence proves first-touch, and the 30-day window clause doesn't apply because the original rejection was based on incomplete information (wrong prospect name 'Helix Bio' vs 'Helix BioSciences').
TechForward Solutions — their deal registration was submitted and approved first, and the 30-day contestation window has expired, making the approval final.
Split credit — TechForward gets 'sourced' and Quantum gets 'influenced' since both contributed to the deal motion but TechForward has the valid registration.

Quantum Consulting Group — the email from Helix's CTO plus the Gartner lead scan prove first-touch on Nov 19, pre-dating TechForward's registration by 18 days, and the sourced attribution policy is first-touch.
